## Checklist

- [ ] `./scripts/check.sh` passes locally, with `--ai`, `--raw` or `--mobile` if the change touches AI, raw decoding or the phone app
- [ ] I have signed the [CLA](../CLA.md) (the bot asks on your first pull request)
- [ ] Documents and code comments this makes wrong are updated
- [ ] A user-visible change has a line in `CHANGELOG.md` under **Unreleased**
- [ ] New interface text goes through `src/i18n` (docs/I18N.md)
